referenceDescription: DEM sample near the Hall of Supreme Harmony, used solely to set the local rendering datum.
encoding: int16 little endian, west-east columns and north-south Web Mercator rows
elevationAttribution: Mapzen Terrain Tiles. SRTM and GMTED2010 terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
imageryAttribution: EOxCloudless — https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016), released under CC BY 4.0. Cropped, resampled and encoded as WebP.
nightAttribution: NASA Earth Observatory / Joshua Stevens, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data from Miguel Román, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Observed 2016 nighttime lights composite, NASA GIBS (VIIRS_Night_Lights). Cropped and resampled.
tileSourcesCoverage: Source files listed are the union of contributing full tile headers. The cropped grid lies on land.
processing: Unexaggerated relief. Subtract local DEM reference and spherical Earth curvature; flatten the modeled urban surface into its local datum. Texture epochs refer to satellite composites.
